subScenes.name: 热情迎接
subScenes.description: 主人热情欢迎朋友到来，表达开心相见。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey! You made it! We were just talking about you!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿！你来了！我们刚在聊你呢！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会，主人热情迎接客人

followUps.text: Haha, wouldn’t miss it for the world! Thanks for having me!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，我怎么可能不来呢？谢谢你邀请我！

followUps.text: Sorry I’m a bit late—traffic was insane!
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉我迟到了，交通太堵了！

followUps.text: I almost didn’t come—I was so tired—but I’m glad I did!
followUps.text_cn: 我本来差点不来了，太累了，但真庆幸我来了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友聚会时，主人热情欢迎你到场后的自然回应，体现真实社交情绪

qaPairs.triggerText: Come in, come in! Grab a drink and join the circle!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 快进来！拿杯饮料，来加入我们吧！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会，主人引导客人融入群体

followUps.text: I’ll take a soda, thanks! Where should I sit?
followUps.text_cn: 我要杯苏打水，谢谢！我坐哪儿？

followUps.text: Beer, please—and I’ll just hang here for a sec, I’m still getting used to the noise!
followUps.text_cn: 来杯啤酒吧，我先在这儿站会儿，还没适应这吵闹声！

followUps.text: Actually, I’m good—I just want to say hi and take a quick photo with everyone!
followUps.text_cn: 其实我不喝了，我就想打个招呼，跟大家拍张快照！

qaPairs.usageNote: 主人邀请你加入聚会时，你的回应需体现个人偏好与社交节奏，避免千篇一律的‘谢谢’

qaPairs.triggerText: You’re finally here! We’ve been waiting to toast you!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你终于来了！我们正等着为你干杯呢！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会，主人准备为客人举杯欢迎

followUps.text: Oh wow, that’s so sweet! I’ll raise my glass to all of you!
followUps.text_cn: 哦天哪，太暖心了！我举杯敬大家！

followUps.text: Wait, I’m not drinking tonight—can I toast with sparkling water?
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，我今晚不喝酒，能用气泡水干杯吗？

followUps.text: Haha, you’re too much! I didn’t even know it was my turn to be honored!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，你们太夸张了！我都不知道今天轮到我被庆祝了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当被突然当众欢迎或举杯时，回应需兼顾礼貌、个性与情境氛围，避免冷场或过度夸张

subScenes.name: 提供饮料
subScenes.description: 主人询问客人想喝什么，并提供饮品选择。

qaPairs.triggerText: What would you like to drink?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会时，有人主动提供饮料选择

followUps.text: I'll have a soda, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我要一杯苏打水，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you have anything non-alcoholic?
followUps.text_cn: 你们有非酒精饮料吗？

followUps.text: I'm good, thanks—I just had one.
followUps.text_cn: 我就不喝了，谢谢，刚喝过。

qaPairs.usageNote: 朋友聚会中，当有人主动问你想喝什么时，可用这三种方式回应：直接选择、确认选项、礼貌拒绝。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友提供热饮选项，场景为晚间聚会

followUps.text: Coffee, please—I need the caffeine!
followUps.text_cn: 我要咖啡，我需要提提神！

followUps.text: Neither, actually—I'll take sparkling water.
followUps.text_cn: 都不选，我来瓶气泡水吧。

followUps.text: Hmm, I'm torn… what do you recommend?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，我犹豫了……你推荐哪个？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当被限定在两个选项时，可直接选、换选项、或反问对方意见，体现自然社交互动。

qaPairs.triggerText: Want me to grab you a beer?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友主动提出帮忙取酒，场景为轻松聚会

followUps.text: Yes, please! Thanks!
followUps.text_cn: 好啊，谢谢！

followUps.text: Nah, I'm cutting back this week.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，这周我在戒酒。

followUps.text: Actually, could you get me a lemonade instead?
followUps.text_cn: 其实你能帮我拿杯柠檬水吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 面对朋友主动帮忙取饮，回应可直接接受、说明拒绝理由、或灵活替换需求，体现真实社交灵活性。

subScenes.name: 寒暄近况
subScenes.description: 双方简单聊聊最近生活，表达关心与问候。

qaPairs.triggerText: What have you been up to lately?

followUps.text: Pretty good! I started a new job last month and loving it so far.
followUps.text_cn: 还不错！我上个月换了新工作，到现在很喜欢。

followUps.text: Not too much—just working and trying to catch up on sleep!
followUps.text_cn: 没太多事，就是上班，顺便补觉！

followUps.text: To be honest, it’s been a bit overwhelming with family stuff, but I’m hanging in there.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，家里事情有点多，但我还撑得住。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然寒暄，回应时可根据真实情绪选择积极、中性或略带压力但不抱怨的语气。

followUps.text: Amazing! I finally took that trip to Japan I’ve been talking about.
followUps.text_cn: 太棒了！我终于去了那趟一直说要来的日本旅行。

followUps.text: Same old, same old—work, gym, Netflix. You know how it is.
followUps.text_cn: 老样子：上班、健身、刷奈飞，你懂的。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m thinking about switching careers—still figuring it out.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我正考虑转行，还在琢磨中。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应时可依据真实生活状态选择分享亮点、日常琐事或人生变化，避免过度夸张或冷淡。

qaPairs.triggerText: How’s life treating you these days?

followUps.text: Can’t complain! Got a new apartment and my cat’s finally adjusted.
followUps.text_cn: 没什么好抱怨的！搬了新公寓，我家猫也适应了。

followUps.text: It’s been a rollercoaster—I’m trying to stay positive.
followUps.text_cn: 起起落落的，但我尽量保持积极。

followUps.text: Honestly? A little lonely. I’ve been meaning to reach out more.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？有点孤单，我一直想多联系人。

qaPairs.usageNote: 此句更口语化，适合亲密朋友间使用。回应可从日常小事到情感状态灵活调整，体现真实人际关系。

subScenes.name: 介绍环境
subScenes.description: 主人带客人认识房间和在场其他朋友。

qaPairs.triggerText: So this is where we hang out on weekends!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 所以这就是我们周末常来的地方！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友介绍聚会地点的环境

followUps.text: Wow, I love the vibe here — the lights and music are so cozy!
followUps.text_cn: 哇，我喜欢这里的氛围——灯光和音乐太温馨了！

followUps.text: It’s nice, but I’m a bit cold — is there a blanket I could borrow?
followUps.text_cn: 还不错，但我有点冷，有毯子可以借吗？

followUps.text: This reminds me of my cousin’s place — same couch and playlist!
followUps.text_cn: 这让我想起我表弟家，沙发和歌单都一样！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应朋友对聚会环境的介绍，表达感受或自然延伸话题

qaPairs.triggerText: We just set up the backyard for the party — what do you think?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们刚把后院布置好办派对——你觉得怎么样？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友展示新布置的户外区域

followUps.text: This is amazing! The string lights and cushions look so festive!
followUps.text_cn: 太棒了！串灯和靠垫看起来超有节日气氛！

followUps.text: It’s cool, but I’m not sure if it’s safe to sit on the grass — is it dry?
followUps.text_cn: 挺酷的，但我担心草地上会不会湿，现在干了吗？

followUps.text: I’m not really into outdoor stuff, but I’ll make it work — thanks for the effort!
followUps.text_cn: 我其实不太喜欢户外，但我会适应的，谢谢你们的用心！

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应朋友对户外布置的展示，可表达欣赏、顾虑或委婉保留意见

qaPairs.triggerText: We moved the snacks to the kitchen table — easier to grab!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们把零食移到厨房桌上了——拿起来更方便！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友说明食物摆放位置的调整

followUps.text: Perfect! I was just about to go look for chips — this is genius!
followUps.text_cn: 太棒了！我正要去找薯片呢——这主意真聪明！

followUps.text: Oh, I’m on a diet — is there anything low-sugar around?
followUps.text_cn: 哦，我在控制饮食，有低糖的零食吗？

followUps.text: I’m not hungry right now, but I’ll keep that in mind for later!
followUps.text_cn: 我现在不饿，但我会记住这里，待会儿再来拿！

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应食物位置调整，可表达感谢、提出特殊需求或中性反馈

subScenes.name: 轻松告别
subScenes.description: 聚会尾声，主人礼貌道别并期待下次再见。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会结束，对方主动提出离开，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Sure, take care! Let’s do this again next week.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，保重！咱们下周再聚！

followUps.text: Already? Can’t you stay a bit longer?
followUps.text_cn: 这么快？不能再多待一会儿吗？

followUps.text: Got it, drive safe!
followUps.text_cn: 明白，开车小心！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友聚会结束时，对对方告别语的自然回应，语气轻松随意，符合非正式社交场景。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在离开前表达感谢，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Anytime! You’re always welcome here.
followUps.text_cn: 随时欢迎！你随时都可以来！

followUps.text: Don’t mention it—had a great time too!
followUps.text_cn: 别客气！我也玩得很开心！

followUps.text: Yeah, next time it’s my turn to host!
followUps.text_cn: 对，下次轮到我请客了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应朋友的感谢，体现社交礼貌与关系维护，避免冷淡或敷衍。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友用非正式方式告别，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Yeah, catch you soon!
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，很快见！

followUps.text: Wait, are you heading home now? I can give you a ride.
followUps.text_cn: 等等，你现在就回家吗？我可以顺路送你。

followUps.text: Yep, take it easy!
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，你慢走！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应模糊告别语，回应可灵活选择：延续互动、表达关心或简洁收尾，符合朋友间自然节奏。
